channel.title: LocalPlumbers: Blog
channel.description: Plain-English plumbing guides for the UK and USA: frozen pipes, leaks, boilers, drains and how to choose a plumber, checked against official sources.

item.title: How to find your stop tap or main water shut-off valve (before you need it)
item.description: Find your stop tap (stopcock) in the UK or main water shut-off valve in the USA before a leak or burst pipe happens. Where it hides and how to test it.

item.title: Carbon monoxide and your boiler or water heater: a winter safety guide
item.description: Carbon monoxide from boilers and water heaters: symptoms, where to fit an alarm, what to do if it sounds and when to call a registered engineer (UK and US).

item.title: Water heater temperature: what to set it to, and why UK and US advice differs
item.description: What temperature should a water heater or hot water cylinder be set to? UK and US official guidance on scalding, legionella and safe checks at the tap.

item.title: Frozen pipes: what to do, and when to call a plumber
item.description: Frozen or burst pipes this winter? Step-by-step advice for UK and US homes on turning off water, thawing safely and when to call a plumber.
